item.title: [DU-2200] Handling of topic seeding
item.description:
Background:

User mistakenly selected French on company onboarding and continues with the other pages. Then user returns to language page and changes selection to German. After completing onboarding, all topics are in French, because the seeding is done in the moment the language is selected and can’t be changed afterwards.

  1. To prevent the situation:
    • if user changes the language selection during onboarding, the seeding is updated to the selected language
  2. If the user has completed onboarding with the wrong language, workflow is as follows:
    • user selects company language
    • user deletes all topics and triggers new seeding, which seeds topics in the new company language

Admir Serifi Currently, seeding topics is not working on the admin.
item.summary: Handling of topic seeding

item.title: [DU-2193] Driving topics ordered differently on different screens
item.description:
Current state:

  1. The order of the driving topics, organized inside phases, is defined on the category topics in the admin platform.
  2. Different screens in the app show a different order:
    1. Assessment view inside the training (both instructor and student) and session, shows the correct order
    2. In the driving session view, instructor sees the wrong order of topics, both on the main view (topic cards) and on the overall list of topics.

    3. In the student app, when the student goes to training details and opens the list of topics on the overview page, the order of topics is entirely different.

Expected behaviour:

All lists throughout the application, show the same order of topics, ass defined on the admin platform.
item.summary: Driving topics ordered differently on different screens

item.title: [DU-2192] Instructor with deactivated profile can't be invited again
item.description:
Preconditions:

  • Instructor has had an active profile in the driving school
  • Instructor has deactivated own profile

Steps:

  1. On the mobile app, open the form to add a new team member
  2. Add all data
  3. Submit form

Result: Team member can’t be invited. System shows error message “Invitation already exists”.

Expected: User can re-invite any former team member, whose profile is inactive. This can be done either through the reinstate button on the admin platform or by repeating the invitation through the invitation form (both on web or mobile).
item.summary: Instructor with deactivated profile can't be invited again

item.title: [DU-2191] Completing training after exam deletes exam appointment
item.description:
Preconditions: Student has an exam appointment on the current day at 12:00 (current time is 09:00)

  1. Start exam appointment

  3. Click “Passed”

Result:

Expected: When completing a training, all upcoming appointments, which have not been “touched”, must be deleted. If user has already added an assessment in an appointment, that appointment can not be deleted.
item.summary: Completing training after exam deletes exam appointment

Expected: Better error handling.
item.summary: Student address saved as a single field on admin causes error on the mobile

comments.comment: Numan Mustafa I believe this was a backend issue that Admir Serifi resolved

Admir Serifi The initial blocker issue is resolved, with a single field on the web. But not all scenarios are working fine.

  1. Address added on the web in the correct format → Address shown correctly on mobile
  2. Address added on mobile (with 3 fields) → Web shows only the address field content, no postal code and no location

I would strongly recommend implementing it identically on both web and mobile.

item.title: [DU-1982] Wrong enum/types
item.description:
PR in github, pls check it: https://github.com/Intelact-Solutions/driveup-mobile/pull/238

Found all string-based checks in driveup-mobile and flagged which ones are enum-candidates.

Enum-candidate string checks

  1. lib/instructor/features/add_instructor/data/data_provider.dart:24
    role == InstructorRole.instructor ? role.name : 'company.manager'
    'company.manager' is a hardcoded role string.
    done
  2. lib/shared/features/profile/data/data_provider/profile_model.dart:79
    name == 'Euro' ? ...
    Comparing currency by name string.
  3. lib/instructor/features/payments/presentation/payment_form.dart:137
    currency.name == 'Euro'
    Same currency-by-name string check.
  4. lib/shared/features/sign_in/presentation/select_language_page.dart:45
    locale.languageCode == 'it'
    done
  5. lib/shared/features/sign_in/presentation/select_language_page.dart:47
    locale.languageCode == 'fr'
    done

String checks likely tied to external APIs/callback contracts (not your own enum)

  1. lib/instructor/features/calendar/presentation/calendar_page.dart:141
    if (val == 'displayDate')
  2. lib/instructor/features/calendar/presentation/calendar_page.dart:160
    else if (val == 'calendarView')
  3. lib/student/features/driving_training/calender/presentation/driving_training_calender_page.dart:85
    if (val == 'displayDate')
  4. lib/shared/core/presentation/widgets/speech_to_text_icon.dart:76
    isRecording = val == 'listening'

String char checks (not enum-related)

  1. lib/shared/features/sign_in/presentation/phone_number.dart:153
  2. lib/shared/features/account_settings/presentation/edit_phone_number.dart:145
  3. lib/instructor/features/add_training/presentation/add_training_form.dart:540
  4. lib/instructor/features/add_instructor/presentation/add_instructor_bottom_sheet.dart:417
    All use ...[0] == '0'.

Generated/localization switch strings (usually keep as-is)

  1. lib/l10n/arb/app_localizations.dart:4266 ('de', 'en', 'fr', 'it')
  2. lib/shared/core/util/extensions/date_time.dart:52 and related locale cases.
item.summary: Wrong enum/types

de

So funktioniert die Abrechnung:

  • Zahlungen prüfen: Entscheide pro Zahlung, ob sie in die aktuelle Abrechnung einfließen oder (z. B. bei Unklarheiten) übersprungen werden soll.
  • Ausgaben verwalten: Du kannst Ausgaben akzeptieren oder ablehnen bzw. eine Ausgabe überspringen, falls sie nicht in die aktuelle Abrechnung inkludiert werden soll.
  • Abschluss: Der finale Betrag zeigt dir genau, wie viel Geld der Fahrlehrer der Fahrschule schuldet oder zurückzuerhalten hat.

it

Ecco come funziona il conteggio:

  • Verifica i pagamenti: decidi per ogni pagamento se includerlo nel conteggio attuale o se saltarlo (ad es. in caso di dubbi).
  • Gestisci le spese: puoi accettare o rifiutare le spese, oppure saltarne una se non deve essere inclusa nel conteggio attuale.
  • Chiusura: l'importo finale ti mostra esattamente quanto denaro l'istruttore deve alla scuola guida o quanto deve ricevere come rimborso.

fr

Voici comment fonctionne le décompte :

  • Vérifier les paiements : décide pour chaque paiement s'il doit être inclus dans le décompte actuel ou s'il doit être ignoré (par ex. en cas d'incertitude).
  • Gérer les dépenses : tu peux accepter ou refuser des dépenses, ou en ignorer une si elle ne doit pas être incluse dans le décompte actuel.
  • Clôture : le montant final t'indique exactement quelle somme le moniteur doit à l'auto-école ou quel montant il doit percevoir en retour.

item.title: [DU-1832] Charts implementation is not user-friendly
item.description:
Issue: Current chart implementation shows every payment or expense as a single dot in the chart, leading to a chaos, which makes the chart unreadable in many cases.

Change proposal:

  1. Show a dot not for each single transaction, but for each day.
    1. If a day has multiple payments, the sum is shown as a dot in the chart
      1. If user is on the 7 day view, only 7 dots are shown
      2. If user is on the 30 day view, 30 dots are shown
  2. Show values in an accumulative manner, as a total of payments or expenses. For example
    1. Day 1: user adds multiple payments (30+40+20), in total 90 CHF → graph shows dot on 90 CHF level
    2. Day 2: user does not add any payment, total sum remains 90 CHF → graph shows dot for day 2 on 90 CHF level (line proceeds horizontally without rise)
    3. Day 3: User adds 60 CHF, total sum is 150 CHF → for day 3, graph shows a dot at 150 CHF
  3. Only payments with status “pending” and “approved” are calculated. Cancellations are not included in the graph. Based on the example from point 2 above:
    1. If user cancels the 30 CHF payment of day 1 → the dot for day 1 is reduced to 60 CHF.
  4. Only expenses with status “pending” or “approved” are calculated. Rejected expenses are not included in the graph.
    1. Day 1: user adds 2 expenses (50 + 20), in total 70 CHF → dot for day 1 shows expenses of 70 CHF in the graph
      1. If both expenses are approved, the dot remains the same
      2. If for example, expense 50 CHF is rejected → dot for day 1 shows expenses of 20 CHF
  5. Implement the same accumulative logic for “Sold services”.
    1. the graph does not graphically display sold services, which are then cancelled. For example:
      1. Day 1: user adds 5 driving appointments (price: 50 CHF each) → dot for day 1: 250 CHF
      2. If 3 of these driving appointments are cancelled, dot for day one is reduced to 150 CHF.
item.summary: Charts implementation is not user-friendly

item.title: [DU-1808] User does not see invitation if it is resent after rejecting the first time
item.description:
1. Invite user as instructor to the company (status in DB: INVITED)
  2. Login as invited user
  3. Reject invitation (status in DB: PENDING)
  4. Invite user again.
  5. Login as invited user

Result: No invitation is visible.

Expected: User should be able to see invitation.

Mohammad Hosein Soleymani Why are we showing user who has rejected as “Pending”? Don’t we have a status “Rejected”?
item.summary: User does not see invitation if it is resent after rejecting the first time

comments.comment:
Numan Mustafa we have four statuses for the account

  1. INVITED : the user had not created an account before being invited, and still hasn’t started the onboarding process of any profiles (accepting invitation, rejecting invitation, creating new profile)
  2. PENDING : the user has signed up in driveup themselves, or they have been invited but has started the onboarding process of one profile (accepting invitation, rejecting invitation, creating new profile), BUT still hasn’t completed onboarding of any profiles
  3. ACTIVE : the user has / has had one active profile in driveup, and hasn’t closed their account
  4. CLOSED : the user has closed their account by choice

when an invited instructor accepts an invitation / rejects an invitation / starts onboarding of another profile (I don’t think it’s possible in the UI if they have pending status, but anyway), they are immediately put in PENDING status

when they reject an invitation, we put their account status in pending, because at this moment, they aren’t an invited user anymore, they have begone their activity in driveup, but they don’t yet have an active profile

and no, we don’t have a rejected status

Mohammad Hosein Soleymani Thanks for the explanation. The problem is that we have no handling, if an instructor by mistake rejects the invitation. You have no chance of inviting him again, which means his number will remain forever pending.

  1. Automated approval on the admin is only for cash payments. The manager has received the money and the money is in his own hands, so no handover is needed.

item.title: [DU-1639] Wrong handling of company address
item.description:
Problem:

  1. Company address is not mandatory for the user to be able to use driveUp.
  2. Company address is mandatory if the user wants to use invoices
  3. In the current implementation, user can start using the app without the company address, BUT once the address has been added, the system does not allow you to delete it → this is a problem in terms of data privacy, since the user should always be available to remove company or personal data.

Solution:

  1. On the company profile page, none of the fields of the address is treated as mandatory → user can edit or delete them any time.
  2. On the “Add address” form, which is triggered from Invoices, all address fields are treated as mandatory → user can’t add an address if one of the fields is empty.
  3. If the user deletes one of the fields on company settings → errors message for missing address is shown anytime the user wants to create a new invoice.
item.summary: Wrong handling of company address

item.title: [DU-1611] Mobile UI/UX change proposals
item.description:
NEXT: Student Profile → Driving Training History, Course Trainings, Agent Profile ako Bog da Imshala

User Profile titles

  1. Instructor
    1. Title: Company Name
    2. Subtitle: Role (Company owner, instructor, manager)
  2. Student
    1. Title: Student Profile
    2. Subtitle: My Learning Platform
  3. Agent:
    1. Title: Agent Profile
    2. Subtitle: My Marketing Platform

      Both title and subtitle must be truncated in a single line!

      The font size of the title and subtitle must be according to the design file.

Switch Profile

  1. Modal description “Zu welchem…“ could be a bit smaller
  2. Remove the label “Profile“
  3. instructor profile:
    1. Company logo
    2. Company name
  4. Student profile:
    1. Education icon
    2. Student Profile
  5. Agent profile:
    1. Marketing/Money icon
    2. Agent Profile
  6. Change Account settings icon to cog
  7. Selected Profile Background color +10-20%

Update Splash Screen (TBD)

Waiting for Hanie to finalise the logo and app symbol

Instructor Landing Page

  1. Appointment card border for today +10-20% highlight
  2. Don’t show pickup location section when location not available (align top)
  3. Truncate student name in a single line
  4. The row under student name (Positions from left to right)
    1. Exam as a badge in warning color (light orange)
    2. Category badge
    3. Transmission badge
  5. Add a light shadow to the search field to make it more visible when scrolling
  6. Add the correct padding between the “Today“ and “Next 30 Days“ sections
  7. If the first day of the “Next 30 days“ section is the next day, the label must be “Tomorrow“ instead of date (see design)

    Make sure that the category badge colours are from the API

    • done

Driving Session

  1. Font size in the 3 dot menu popup is too large
  2. Session header (Kimiya: I implemented this based on the new design but I think the new design as more wasted space and would not look good on smaller phone sizes)
    1. move back button, date and time to the first row
    2. In the second row, move category and transmission badges before balance
    3. transform balance to badge design and use green and red colours for positive and 0 (green), and negative numbers
    4. Add currency to balance
  3. Topic images borders are lost on the edges ��
    1. NOTE: The actual issue is the fact that the images themselves have a black border and that is what’s causing the issue. Admir will remove the borders.
  4. Student Signature
    1. Remove student image and category (Kimiya: are you sure �� I think it looks weird with just the name)
    2. Use larger font size for student name
    3. Add more padding between the signature area and the description and between the description and the action buttons (see design)
    4. Add border or background to signature area
    5. Signature area must have the same padding on left and right
  5. Notes
    1. Add border to the current note area (there is a lack of feeling that it is an input field)
    2. Save and Cancel action icons are too on the fly. Make them feel more like buttons and move them to center
    3. Use icons for Edit, Delete, Save and Cancel in past appointments (you can use the same look and feel for new note action buttons)
    4. Remove the description from the empty state. The title is enough
  6. Session topic Empty states
    1. If no topic image is available, show an image placeholder
    2. If no skills are available, show an empty state
  7. Add Payment
    1. Remove the rounded corners from the header and let the black header background be stretched
    2. Add currency to the balance
    3. Add currency badge to the amount field (not just here but everywhere as in design)
  8. Exam Mode Passed congratulations screen
    1. The subtitle is not centered
    2. Balance has no currency
  9. Cancel appointment confirmation (both from within the session and from the 3 dot menu in the instructor landing page)
    1. The look and feel of the confirmation message is completely different from other confirmations in the app. You can use a popup like “Delete Payment“ confirmation.
  10. Not Editable driving sessions (Not current day sessions)
    1. The user must be able to remove the alert but every time the user reopens even the same session, the alert must be shown again
  11. Session History
    1. the session history header height is too large. The dots, the paddings, and the date and time can all be smaller.










Global

  1. Help icon from the header must lead the user to the public page learning hub
    1. HINT: There was a bug ticket that said this icon should be removed. We decided to remove it for now and return it when the learning hub is actually functional.
  2. The spinner loader is too small. Must be up to 200 - 300% larger.
  3. +New popup from global header
    1. The font size is too large
    2. Remove icons
  4. Full page popups heights (like notes and add payment in session (too high) or notifications (too low)) are not the same throughout the app. Sometimes they go too high and sometime too low. You can use a standard height to be aligned to the upper border of the global header +New button
  5. speech to text only always functions in English. it must be language dependant.

Calendar

  1. The initial viewpoint of the calendar always starts at midnight. The perfect start of the viewpoint would be the current time minus one hour
  2. refresh by swipe down is not implemented on the calendar
  3. Course appointment item is rendered incorrectly (the actual time of the appointment in the screenshot is 3:15 - 4:15)
  4. Calendar item rendering does not work properly when there are more than 2 intersecting items
    1. Do not show images when there are more than 2 intersecting items
  5. Calendar date picker
    1. Title: Select Date instead of pick date range
    2. Go To instead of Submit for button title
    3. Allow navigating to the past
  6. Please take a look at the week view and see if the view is ok. We had complaints from Numan and the testers.

Trainings

  1. Change module name to Trainings (plural) instead of Training
  2. Category, transmission and balance must be in badge look and fell and on the second row under student name (both active and archived)

  1. In sorting, remove the tick for selected item and add either a background color or highlighted text (implement the same for all sorts in the app)

  2. Pickup location:
    1. click on the address should open edit pickup location
    2. click on map marker should open the location on map
  3. License
    1. Date picker title: Select Date instead of pick a range
    2. on click open license edit

  4. Add payment success message is in the middle of the screen. It should be at the bottom like everywhere else

  5. Show student card in new design as explained before

Business Module

  1. Handover
    1. Update the team member selection screen title to “Select Instructor“
    2. Total approved expenses has a “-“ when the amount is 0 in the handover list and confirmation screen
    3. After the handover is submitted and confirmed, the user has the option to go to the history or to click “Okay“. Currently after clicking okay, the user stays on the handover form of the selected instructor. It would make more sense to take the user to the business module.



  2. History chart
    1. The Chart does not get updated when the payments change (for example when I delete a payment, not even after I refresh the page). It only gets updated when I close the app and reopen.
    2. How did we get the payments line to go below the X axis? ��
    3. Remove the “History“ and “Unit: [CURRENCY]“ and stretch the last week and last month tabs

  3. Add payment
    1. In add payment, the title must be “Select a student” instead of “Training“

Account Settings

  1. Working Days and Hours
    1. Remove From & To labels
    2. We must have 15 minute steps in set time instead of 5 because of calendar issues

  2. Calendar Link opens notifications preferences
  3. When creating a new driving school profile, the user lands on the company name screen. When the user clicks on the back button, the user lands on the personal data screen (full name and image of the user), and then on another back, the user lands on the profile selection screen.
    1. expected behaviour: The personal data screen must be skipped on back action from company data screen and the user must land directly on the profile selection screen. Please pay attention that this is the case on profile creation from account settings. Onboarding from the start page is ok as is.

Onboarding

  1. Start Page pre-selected country
    1. Store user country in the local storage
    2. if country found in local storage, pre-select the country regardless of the IP location
    3. if country not found in local storage, fetch country from IP info service (communicate with Admir)
      1. if country is supported, pre-select country
      2. else, pre-select first country in the list
  2. Start page Language
    1. Why don’t we immediately change the app language when the user has selected a single language country (Germany). The current implementation is that the user selects Germany, the user gives OTP, selects profile type, sees preparation splash screen, and only then the app language changes to german. Why wouldn’t we change the app language already on the start screen. To simplify:
      1. Get language from local storage → switch app to the language
      2. If not found OR when user changes selected country
        1. if selected country is single language → switch app language
        2. if selected country has multiple languages
          1. if local storage language is one of the country languages → switch to the local storage language
          2. else if device language is one of the country languages → switch to device language
          3. else go to fallback language → English
          4. HINT: ALL OF THE ABOVE IS ONLY RELEVANT FOR THE SCREENS BEFORE THE USER SELECTS A LAGUAGE, OR BEFORE WE RECEIVE THE EXISTING USER LANGUAGE FROM TH API
  3. Image crop screen
    1. The bottom action button are mostly behind the device navigation menu
    2. Top buttons are too close to the screen edge (had to click a few times to catch)
  1. Promotion code
    1. When code is matched, the user cannot edit the code anymore
    2. The success and error messages stay on the screen when the user goes back a step and returns to the promotion code screen (in case of success as shown below, the success message is still visible although the code is not anymore and the user (even the tester �� does not know if the code is going to be assigned or not))
    3. Expected behaviour:
      1. The code and the error/success message stay
      2. The code is always editable

Student Profile

  1. Landing
    1. Empty state
      1. The empty state says No Appointments but the landing of the student profile is reserved for trainings list not appointments.
  2. Training Overview
    1. In charge instructor: Move the in-charge instructor description under the in-charge instructor name (2 rows aligned with the instructor image) to save space. This section takes too much screen height
    2. in the progress section, remove the show details button and add an arrow just like the one in front of the Appointments section (Termine >)
      1. You would have to lower the pie chart a little bit and position it aligned with the X/Y topics
    3. Student Experience rating edit pop-up is half-hidden
      1. DISCUSS WITH Numan Mustafa : Maybe the best approach would be to remove all experience ratings except the one we have on the landing page that shows up when the training is terminated/completed. We are giving too much space for adding a rating on day 1 and then editing it forever etc. We could additionally show the student how he/she rated the experience in the finished training overview as read-only.
    4. in the topics screen, show badges and topics as explained in the instructor app driving session above.


  1. Terminated/Completed Training overview (this part is completely forgotten in development)
    1. Add status card on the top (except that instead of Date, implement period start date - end date)
    2. Keep showing Appointments and Progress cards
    3. Remove Start Date and Exam estimation section
    4. Remove pickup location
    5. Grey out Calendar in navigation menu. It should not be clickable

Agent Profile

the one related to earnings has been skipped based on the discussion between Numan and I (Kimiya). Our logic was that in this way new users would know what data they would expect in this page (there was previously a bug ticket reported for this to be shown)

item.title: [DU-1503] Calendar shown in 5 min intervals
item.description:
1. Open calendar module
  2. Inspect time intervals

Result: Calendar shows 5 min time intervals.

Expected: Calendar should have hourly time intervals.
item.summary: Calendar shown in 5 min intervals

comments.comment:
Numan Mustafa This is caused by fixing the bug that I have linked to this one.
Resulting the discussion that I had with Admir Serifi we decided that the cleanest and cheapest way to show non working hours correctly in the calendar is to divide hours by 5mins because globally our time interval fields have 5min steps and from a talk that I had with Ehsan Eydi that can’t be changed. so I should be able to detect 5min intervals in the calendar hour segments to correctly highlight non working hours.

Babak Khademi I understand the reason why we are in this situation. But from a user perspective, the current state is not acceptable. There is an absurdly long scrolling for me to even view any appointment.

Admir Serifi Ehsan Eydi And the fact that we use 5 min time intervals should not force us to show the calendar in five minute intervals. You can take google calendar as an example. It is organized in 15 min time intervals, but the calendar is still shown in full hours. So independent of the intervals we have, we need to show the calendar in full hours.
Numan Mustafa Of course. I agree that the calendar must be shown in full hour sections.

item.summary: Returning form language selection on onboarding saves the selected language for the app

comments.comment: Retest failed Ehsan Eydi Same behavior is observed
Retest failed Ehsan Eydi Same behavior observed
Erta Kokomani Let’s discuss the current behaviour in a next session.

Based on our discussion, the new implementation works as follows:

  • When a user opens the app for the first time, the initial language is set to the device language if it is supported; otherwise, it defaults to English.
  • When the user selects a language on the language selection page, that language will be applied to both the language selection page itself and the profile type selection page.
  • If the user navigates back to the sign-in page without completing the setup, the language on the sign-in page will revert to the device language (if supported) or English.
  • After the user proceeds from the language selection page, the chosen language is stored locally and becomes the default language for the sign-in page whenever the user is logged out.

Merging issue shold happens on api, ui must reload component after submit
